title: email
description: An email thread (ADR-017 §6, record). Never carries a capture_id: the thread's first Message-ID is its resource.

from_name.description: The name the thread's first message gives its sender, as its From header writes it. Written for emails filed since the archivist keeps the sender; older cards have none.

from_address.description: The address of the thread's first message's sender, from its From header.

model.description: The model that read the source.
